note: Ceftriaxone is primarily available as injectable formulations (IV/IM) and is NOT commonly available as oral pills in the United States. Oral cephalosporins exist (cephalexin, cefdinir, etc.) but ceftriaxone specifically is not formulated as a standard oral tablet or capsule.
disclaimer: Ceftriaxone does not have FDA-approved oral pill/tablet/capsule variants in the US market. All formulations listed are injectable. For oral cephalosporin options, alternative agents like cephalexin or cefdinir should be consulted.
